spells.zhDescription: 沿视线射出可碰撞的单发飞矢，只命中路径上首个敌人。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加点燃；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加局部爆发。
spells.enDescription: Fires a colliding projectile along the aim direction, hitting only the first enemy in its path. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply ignite; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply area burst.

spells.zhDescription: 发射瞬时穿透射线，按路径依次命中多个敌人，实体和实心墙分别处理。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加遮蔽视野；命中时且目标在六格外：对命中者施加显形，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Projects an instant piercing ray through several enemies; solid walls terminate its path. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply blind; On a hit beyond six blocks: to the struck target apply reveal, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 向前展开扇形吐息，只覆盖视线角度内的近距离敌人。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加击退；命中时且目标在六格内：对命中者施加遮蔽视野，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Unfolds a forward cone of breath, covering only nearby enemies within its viewing angle. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply push; On a hit within six blocks: to the struck target apply blind, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 以自身为圆心释放环形冲击，向各方向扩散。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加挑空；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加击落。
spells.enDescription: Releases an expanding radial shock centered on the caster. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply launch; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply slam.

spells.zhDescription: 召唤围绕自身旋转的卫星，靠近者被依次触发接触伤害。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对自身施加吸收护盾；重复命中同一目标且目标在六格内：对命中者施加打断吟唱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates satellites orbiting the caster; approaching enemies trigger successive contact hits. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the caster apply gain absorption; When hitting the same target again within six blocks: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 由首个命中目标跳跃到附近未命中的敌人，每个目标只传导一次。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加点燃；命中时：对命中者施加消耗目标魔力，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Jumps from the first struck enemy to nearby unvisited enemies; each target conducts only once. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply ignite; On a hit: to the struck target apply burn enemy mana, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 发出沿地面推进的波前，行进中的窄带依次命中沿途敌人。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加击退；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）且目标着地：对最后命中者施加缠根。
spells.enDescription: Sends a narrow ground wave forward, successively striking enemies crossed by its advancing front. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply push; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot) against a grounded target: to the last struck target apply root.

spells.zhDescription: 在瞄准地点形成持续旋涡，先聚拢再周期性施加伤害。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加牵引；重复命中同一目标且目标悬空：对命中者施加击落，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a persistent vortex at the aimed point, pulling targets in before periodic damage. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply pull; When hitting the same target again against an airborne target: to the struck target apply slam, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 标记瞄准地点，从上空延迟降下陨星，落点产生范围冲击。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加点燃；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加减速。

On the first hit: to the struck target apply ignite; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply slow.

spells.zhDescription: 在瞄准地面埋设可见陷阱，首个敌人踏入时引爆并消失。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加缠根；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.6秒）。
spells.enDescription: Places a visible ground trap that detonates and disappears when the first enemy enters. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply root; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.6 seconds).

spells.zhDescription: 沿朝向安全突进，穿过路径上的敌人造成冲撞命中。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加击退；命中时：对命中者施加减速，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Rushes safely forward, striking enemies crossed along the path. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply push; On a hit: to the struck target apply slow, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 跃迁至视线中的安全落脚点，出发和抵达处分别产生短程冲击。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对自身施加净化负面效果；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对自身施加吸收护盾。
spells.enDescription: Blinks to a safe aimed landing point, creating short shockwaves at departure and arrival. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the caster apply cleanse; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the caster apply gain absorption.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点建立临时魔法障壁，对试图穿越的敌人反复阻挡并施加伤害。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加点燃；重复命中同一目标且目标着地：对命中者施加截断惯性，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Erects a temporary magical barrier that repeatedly blocks and strikes enemies attempting to cross. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply ignite; When hitting the same target again against a grounded target: to the struck target apply halt velocity, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 生成随身防护与反击环，被敌人贴身攻击时触发反击。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对自身施加吸收护盾；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回复生命，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒。

On the first hit: to the caster apply gain absorption; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply heal, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 召唤短时存续的魔法使魔，自动寻找合法敌人并持续攻击。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加点燃；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回复生命，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Summons a temporary familiar that automatically acquires eligible enemies and attacks them. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. spells.zhDescription: 向首个瞄准敌人施加可见印记，延迟后引爆，离开距离上限则失效。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加虚弱；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.6秒）。

spells.zhDescription: 锁定前方敌人，按实际伤害汲取生命；不能从友军与无效目标获益。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对自身施加回收魔力；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）且曾实际命中敌人：对自身施加吸收护盾。

spells.zhDescription: 持续引导多次脉冲，移动过远、受限或死亡时中止剩余脉冲。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加点燃；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加打断吟唱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Channels repeated pulses; excessive movement, lost eligibility or death cancels remaining pulses. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. spells.zhDescription: 记录首次命中的位置，延迟在原地点重放冲击，敌人可及时躲开。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.5秒）；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加缠根，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Records the first hit location and replays the impact there after a delay, allowing enemies to dodge. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点展开大范围持续领域，周期性作用于领域内的合法敌人。 点燃目标；已燃烧的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：在记录的落点施加局部爆发；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回收魔力，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加点燃、局部爆发，整次施法最多3次，整次施法共用间隔至少2.0秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a large persistent field at the aimed point, periodically affecting eligible enemies inside. Ignites targets and deals bonus damage to already burning enemies. spells.zhDescription: 召唤短时存续的魔法使魔，自动寻找合法敌人并持续攻击。 熄火、附着潮湿并使后续雷击传导。 首次命中：对命中者施加浸湿熄火；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回复生命，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Summons a temporary familiar that automatically acquires eligible enemies and attacks them. Extinguishes fire, applies wetness and conducts subsequent lightning. On the first hit: to the struck target apply douse; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply heal, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 向首个瞄准敌人施加可见印记，延迟后引爆，离开距离上限则失效。 熄火、附着潮湿并使后续雷击传导。 首次命中：对命中者施加虚弱；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加局部爆发。
spells.enDescription: Brands the first aimed enemy for delayed detonation; excessive distance breaks the brand. Extinguishes fire, applies wetness and conducts subsequent lightning. On the first hit: to the struck target apply weaken; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply area burst.

spells.zhDescription: 锁定前方敌人，按实际伤害汲取生命；不能从友军与无效目标获益。 熄火、附着潮湿并使后续雷击传导。 首次命中：对自身施加回复生命；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）且曾实际命中敌人：对自身施加回收魔力。

On the first hit: to the caster apply heal; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot) after actually striking an enemy: to the caster apply restore mana.

spells.zhDescription: 持续引导多次脉冲，移动过远、受限或死亡时中止剩余脉冲。 熄火、附着潮湿并使后续雷击传导。 首次命中：对命中者施加浸湿熄火；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加打断吟唱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Channels repeated pulses; excessive movement, lost eligibility or death cancels remaining pulses. Extinguishes fire, applies wetness and conducts subsequent lightning. On the first hit: to the struck target apply douse; When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 记录首次命中的位置，延迟在原地点重放冲击，敌人可及时躲开。 熄火、附着潮湿并使后续雷击传导。 首次命中：对命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.5秒）；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加消耗目标魔力，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Records the first hit location and replays the impact there after a delay, allowing enemies to dodge. Extinguishes fire, applies wetness and conducts subsequent lightning. On the first hit: to the struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.5 seconds); When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply burn enemy mana, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点展开大范围持续领域，周期性作用于领域内的合法敌人。 熄火、附着潮湿并使后续雷击传导。 首次命中：对自身施加回收魔力；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回复生命，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加浸湿熄火、击退，整次施法最多3次，整次施法共用间隔至少2.0秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a large persistent field at the aimed point, periodically affecting eligible enemies inside. Extinguishes fire, applies wetness and conducts subsequent lightning. On the first hit: to the caster apply restore mana; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply heal, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply douse, push, at most 3 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 2.0 seconds.

On the first hit: to the struck target apply launch; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot) against a grounded target: to the last struck target apply root.

spells.zhDescription: 在瞄准地点形成持续旋涡，先聚拢再周期性施加伤害。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加牵引；重复命中同一目标且目标悬空：对命中者施加减速，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a persistent vortex at the aimed point, pulling targets in before periodic damage. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply pull; When hitting the same target again against an airborne target: to the struck target apply slow, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 标记瞄准地点，从上空延迟降下陨星，落点产生范围冲击。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加击落；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加局部爆发。
spells.enDescription: Marks an aimed point for a delayed falling star and an impact explosion. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply slam; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply area burst.

spells.zhDescription: 在瞄准地面埋设可见陷阱，首个敌人踏入时引爆并消失。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加截断惯性；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.6秒）。
spells.enDescription: Places a visible ground trap that detonates and disappears when the first enemy enters. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply halt velocity; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.6 seconds).

spells.zhDescription: 沿朝向安全突进，穿过路径上的敌人造成冲撞命中。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加挑空；命中时：对命中者施加减速，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Rushes safely forward, striking enemies crossed along the path. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply launch; On a hit: to the struck target apply slow, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 跃迁至视线中的安全落脚点，出发和抵达处分别产生短程冲击。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对自身施加净化负面效果；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加缠根。
spells.enDescription: Blinks to a safe aimed landing point, creating short shockwaves at departure and arrival. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the caster apply cleanse; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply root.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点建立临时魔法障壁，对试图穿越的敌人反复阻挡并施加伤害。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加击退；重复命中同一目标且目标着地：对命中者施加截断惯性，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Erects a temporary magical barrier that repeatedly blocks and strikes enemies attempting to cross. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply push; When hitting the same target again against a grounded target: to the struck target apply halt velocity, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 生成随身防护与反击环，被敌人贴身攻击时触发反击。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对自身施加吸收护盾；重复命中同一目标且目标在六格内：对命中者施加减速，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a personal ward and retaliation ring triggered by close enemy attacks. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the caster apply gain absorption; When hitting the same target again within six blocks: to the struck target apply slow, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 召唤短时存续的魔法使魔，自动寻找合法敌人并持续攻击。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加击退；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回复生命，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Summons a temporary familiar that automatically acquires eligible enemies and attacks them. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply push; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply heal, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 向首个瞄准敌人施加可见印记，延迟后引爆，离开距离上限则失效。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加遮蔽视野；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.6秒）。
spells.enDescription: Brands the first aimed enemy for delayed detonation; excessive distance breaks the brand. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply blind; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.6 seconds).

spells.zhDescription: 锁定前方敌人，按实际伤害汲取生命；不能从友军与无效目标获益。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对自身施加回收魔力；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）且目标生命低于一半：对最后命中者施加虚弱。
spells.enDescription: Locks onto a forward enemy and siphons life from actual damage; friendly or invalid targets yield nothing. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the caster apply restore mana; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot) against a target below half health: to the last struck target apply weaken.

spells.zhDescription: 持续引导多次脉冲，移动过远、受限或死亡时中止剩余脉冲。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加牵引；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加打断吟唱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Channels repeated pulses; excessive movement, lost eligibility or death cancels remaining pulses. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply pull; When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 记录首次命中的位置，延迟在原地点重放冲击，敌人可及时躲开。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.5秒）；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加击落，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Records the first hit location and replays the impact there after a delay, allowing enemies to dodge. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.5 seconds); When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply slam, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点展开大范围持续领域，周期性作用于领域内的合法敌人。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加悬浮；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回收魔力，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加挑空、击退，整次施法最多3次，整次施法共用间隔至少2.0秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a large persistent field at the aimed point, periodically affecting eligible enemies inside. Pushes and lifts targets, scattering persistent fields. On the first hit: to the struck target apply levitate; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply restore mana, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply launch, push, at most 3 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 2.0 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 沿视线射出可碰撞的单发飞矢，只命中路径上首个敌人。 获得短暂抗性，命中施加沉重减速并击落上升中的目标。 首次命中：对命中者施加击落；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.6秒）。
spells.enDescription: Fires a colliding projectile along the aim direction, hitting only the first enemy in its path. Grants brief resistance, slows struck enemies and grounds rising targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply slam; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.6 seconds).

spells.zhDescription: 发射瞬时穿透射线，按路径依次命中多个敌人，实体和实心墙分别处理。 获得短暂抗性，命中施加沉重减速并击落上升中的目标。 首次命中：对命中者施加缠根；命中时且目标在六格外：对命中者施加显形，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Projects an instant piercing ray through several enemies; solid walls terminate its path. Grants brief resistance, slows struck enemies and grounds rising targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply root; On a hit beyond six blocks: to the struck target apply reveal, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 向前展开扇形吐息，只覆盖视线角度内的近距离敌人。 获得短暂抗性，命中施加沉重减速并击落上升中的目标。 首次命中：对命中者施加遮蔽视野；命中时且目标在六格内：对命中者施加击退，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Unfolds a forward cone of breath, covering only nearby enemies within its viewing angle. Grants brief resistance, slows struck enemies and grounds rising targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply blind; On a hit within six blocks: to the struck target apply push, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 以自身为圆心释放环形冲击，向各方向扩散。 获得短暂抗性，命中施加沉重减速并击落上升中的目标。 首次命中：对命中者施加挑空；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加截断惯性。
spells.enDescription: Releases an expanding radial shock centered on the caster. Grants brief resistance, slows struck enemies and grounds rising targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply launch; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply halt velocity.

spells.zhDescription: 召唤围绕自身旋转的卫星，靠近者被依次触发接触伤害。 获得短暂抗性，命中施加沉重减速并击落上升中的目标。 首次命中：对自身施加吸收护盾；重复命中同一目标且目标在六格内：对命中者施加虚弱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates satellites orbiting the caster; approaching enemies trigger successive contact hits. Grants brief resistance, slows struck enemies and grounds rising targets. spells.enDescription: Jumps from the first struck enemy to nearby unvisited enemies; each target conducts only once. Grants brief resistance, slows struck enemies and grounds rising targets. spells.zhDescription: 跃迁至视线中的安全落脚点，出发和抵达处分别产生短程冲击。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对自身施加回复生命；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对自身施加净化负面效果。
spells.enDescription: Blinks to a safe aimed landing point, creating short shockwaves at departure and arrival. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the caster apply heal; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the caster apply cleanse.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点建立临时魔法障壁，对试图穿越的敌人反复阻挡并施加伤害。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对命中者施加显形；重复命中同一目标且目标着地：对命中者施加截断惯性，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Erects a temporary magical barrier that repeatedly blocks and strikes enemies attempting to cross. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the struck target apply reveal; When hitting the same target again against a grounded target: to the struck target apply halt velocity, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 生成随身防护与反击环，被敌人贴身攻击时触发反击。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对自身施加吸收护盾；重复命中同一目标且目标在六格内：对命中者施加挑空，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a personal ward and retaliation ring triggered by close enemy attacks. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the caster apply gain absorption; When hitting the same target again within six blocks: to the struck target apply launch, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 召唤短时存续的魔法使魔，自动寻找合法敌人并持续攻击。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对命中者施加显形；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回复生命，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Summons a temporary familiar that automatically acquires eligible enemies and attacks them. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the struck target apply reveal; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply heal, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 向首个瞄准敌人施加可见印记，延迟后引爆，离开距离上限则失效。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对命中者施加虚弱；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加减速。
spells.enDescription: Brands the first aimed enemy for delayed detonation; excessive distance breaks the brand. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the struck target apply weaken; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply slow.

spells.zhDescription: 锁定前方敌人，按实际伤害汲取生命；不能从友军与无效目标获益。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对自身施加回复生命；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）且曾实际命中敌人：对自身施加净化负面效果。
spells.enDescription: Locks onto a forward enemy and siphons life from actual damage; friendly or invalid targets yield nothing. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the caster apply heal; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot) after actually striking an enemy: to the caster apply cleanse.

spells.zhDescription: 持续引导多次脉冲，移动过远、受限或死亡时中止剩余脉冲。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对自身施加净化负面效果；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加打断吟唱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Channels repeated pulses; excessive movement, lost eligibility or death cancels remaining pulses. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the caster apply cleanse; When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 记录首次命中的位置，延迟在原地点重放冲击，敌人可及时躲开。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.5秒）；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加虚弱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Records the first hit location and replays the impact there after a delay, allowing enemies to dodge. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.5 seconds); When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply weaken, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点展开大范围持续领域，周期性作用于领域内的合法敌人。 净化自身中毒、虚弱、失明与凋零，显露敌人并对亡灵增伤。 首次命中：对自身施加回收魔力；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加打断吟唱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加显形、虚弱，整次施法最多3次，整次施法共用间隔至少2.0秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a large persistent field at the aimed point, periodically affecting eligible enemies inside. Cleanses poison, weakness, blindness and wither, reveals enemies and sears undead. On the first hit: to the caster apply restore mana; When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply reveal, weaken, at most 3 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 2.0 seconds.

On the first hit: to the struck target apply weaken; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply levitate.

spells.zhDescription: 锁定前方敌人，按实际伤害汲取生命；不能从友军与无效目标获益。 施加毒素与缠根减速；伤害残血目标时回复生命。 首次命中：对自身施加回复生命；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）且目标生命低于一半：对最后命中者施加虚弱。
spells.enDescription: Locks onto a forward enemy and siphons life from actual damage; friendly or invalid targets yield nothing. Poisons and roots movement, healing the caster when damaging wounded targets. On the first hit: to the caster apply heal; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot) against a target below half health: to the last struck target apply weaken.

spells.zhDescription: 持续引导多次脉冲，移动过远、受限或死亡时中止剩余脉冲。 施加毒素与缠根减速；伤害残血目标时回复生命。 首次命中：对命中者施加中毒；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加打断吟唱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Channels repeated pulses; excessive movement, lost eligibility or death cancels remaining pulses. Poisons and roots movement, healing the caster when damaging wounded targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply poison; When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 记录首次命中的位置，延迟在原地点重放冲击，敌人可及时躲开。 施加毒素与缠根减速；伤害残血目标时回复生命。 首次命中：对命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.5秒）；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加击退，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Records the first hit location and replays the impact there after a delay, allowing enemies to dodge. Poisons and roots movement, healing the caster when damaging wounded targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.5 seconds); When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply push, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点展开大范围持续领域，周期性作用于领域内的合法敌人。 施加毒素与缠根减速；伤害残血目标时回复生命。 首次命中：对命中者施加中毒；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回收魔力，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加缠根、中毒，整次施法最多3次，整次施法共用间隔至少2.0秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a large persistent field at the aimed point, periodically affecting eligible enemies inside. Poisons and roots movement, healing the caster when damaging wounded targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply poison; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply restore mana, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply root, poison, at most 3 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 2.0 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 沿视线射出可碰撞的单发飞矢，只命中路径上首个敌人。 牵引目标并压低高度；下坠的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加牵引；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加局部爆发。
spells.enDescription: Fires a colliding projectile along the aim direction, hitting only the first enemy in its path. Pulls targets inward and downward, dealing bonus damage to falling enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply pull; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply area burst.

spells.zhDescription: 发射瞬时穿透射线，按路径依次命中多个敌人，实体和实心墙分别处理。 牵引目标并压低高度；下坠的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加击落；命中时且目标在六格外：对命中者施加显形，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Projects an instant piercing ray through several enemies; solid walls terminate its path. Pulls targets inward and downward, dealing bonus damage to falling enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply slam; On a hit beyond six blocks: to the struck target apply reveal, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 向前展开扇形吐息，只覆盖视线角度内的近距离敌人。 牵引目标并压低高度；下坠的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加悬浮；命中时且目标在六格内：对命中者施加遮蔽视野，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Unfolds a forward cone of breath, covering only nearby enemies within its viewing angle. Pulls targets inward and downward, dealing bonus damage to falling enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply levitate; On a hit within six blocks: to the struck target apply blind, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 以自身为圆心释放环形冲击，向各方向扩散。 环形爆压将敌人推离自身；下坠目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对命中者施加挑空；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加显形。
spells.enDescription: Releases an expanding radial shock centered on the caster. The pressure burst pushes enemies outward and deals bonus damage to falling targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply launch; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply reveal.

spells.zhDescription: 召唤围绕自身旋转的卫星，靠近者被依次触发接触伤害。 牵引目标并压低高度；下坠的目标承受额外伤害。 首次命中：对自身施加吸收护盾；重复命中同一目标且目标在六格内：对命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.6秒），整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。

On the first hit: to the struck target apply wither; When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 记录首次命中的位置，延迟在原地点重放冲击，敌人可及时躲开。 施法献祭少量生命，命中施加流血并从实际伤害中吸取生命。 首次命中：对命中者施加延迟追击（延迟0.5秒）；重复命中同一目标：对命中者施加中毒，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Records the first hit location and replays the impact there after a delay, allowing enemies to dodge. Sacrifices a little health on casting, applies bleeding and siphons life from actual damage. On the first hit: to the struck target apply delayed strike (after 0.5 seconds); When hitting the same target again: to the struck target apply poison, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 在目标地点展开大范围持续领域，周期性作用于领域内的合法敌人。 施法献祭少量生命，命中施加流血并从实际伤害中吸取生命。 首次命中：对命中者施加流血凋零；重复命中同一目标：对自身施加回收魔力，整次施法最多4次，整次施法共用间隔至少0.5秒；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加流血凋零、虚弱，整次施法最多3次，整次施法共用间隔至少2.0秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a large persistent field at the aimed point, periodically affecting eligible enemies inside. Sacrifices a little health on casting, applies bleeding and siphons life from actual damage. On the first hit: to the struck target apply wither; When hitting the same target again: to the caster apply restore mana, at most 4 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 0.5 seconds; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply wither, weaken, at most 3 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 2.0 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 沿视线射出可碰撞的单发飞矢，只命中路径上首个敌人。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加显形；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加击退。
spells.enDescription: Fires a colliding projectile along the aim direction, hitting only the first enemy in its path. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply reveal; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply push.

spells.zhDescription: 发射瞬时穿透射线，按路径依次命中多个敌人，实体和实心墙分别处理。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加虚弱；命中时且目标在六格外：对命中者施加消耗目标魔力，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Projects an instant piercing ray through several enemies; solid walls terminate its path. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply weaken; On a hit beyond six blocks: to the struck target apply burn enemy mana, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 向前展开扇形吐息，只覆盖视线角度内的近距离敌人。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加遮蔽视野；命中时且目标在六格内：对命中者施加缠根，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Unfolds a forward cone of breath, covering only nearby enemies within its viewing angle. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply blind; On a hit within six blocks: to the struck target apply root, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 以自身为圆心释放环形冲击，向各方向扩散。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加挑空；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加牵引。
spells.enDescription: Releases an expanding radial shock centered on the caster. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply launch; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply pull.

spells.zhDescription: 召唤围绕自身旋转的卫星，靠近者被依次触发接触伤害。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对自身施加吸收护盾；重复命中同一目标且目标在六格内：对命中者施加打断吟唱、虚弱，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates satellites orbiting the caster; approaching enemies trigger successive contact hits. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the caster apply gain absorption; When hitting the same target again within six blocks: to the struck target apply interrupt casting, weaken, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 由首个命中目标跳跃到附近未命中的敌人，每个目标只传导一次。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加显形；命中时：对命中者施加减速，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Jumps from the first struck enemy to nearby unvisited enemies; each target conducts only once. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply reveal; On a hit: to the struck target apply slow, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 发出沿地面推进的波前，行进中的窄带依次命中沿途敌人。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加击退；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）且目标着地：对最后命中者施加挑空。
spells.enDescription: Sends a narrow ground wave forward, successively striking enemies crossed by its advancing front. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply push; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot) against a grounded target: to the last struck target apply launch.

spells.zhDescription: 在瞄准地点形成持续旋涡，先聚拢再周期性施加伤害。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加牵引；重复命中同一目标且目标悬空：对命中者施加消耗目标魔力，整次施法最多4次，同一目标间隔至少0.5秒。
spells.enDescription: Creates a persistent vortex at the aimed point, pulling targets in before periodic damage. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply pull; When hitting the same target again against an airborne target: to the struck target apply burn enemy mana, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.zhDescription: 标记瞄准地点，从上空延迟降下陨星，落点产生范围冲击。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加显形；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加流血凋零。

spells.zhDescription: 在瞄准地面埋设可见陷阱，首个敌人踏入时引爆并消失。 显露隐形目标并施加虚弱；灵魂飞矢具有追踪能力。 首次命中：对命中者施加缠根；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加流血凋零。

On the first hit: to the struck target apply push; On a hit: to the struck target apply wither, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

On the first hit: to the struck target apply reveal; When hitting the same target again against a grounded target: to the struck target apply weaken, at most 4 times per cast, at least this interval per target: 0.5 seconds.

spells.enDescription: Brands the first aimed enemy for delayed detonation; excessive distance breaks the brand. Reveals invisible targets and weakens their attacks; spirit lances seek enemies. On the first hit: to the struck target apply weaken; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply slam.

On the first hit: to the struck target apply ignite, root; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply root, at most 6 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 1.0 seconds; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply area burst.

spells.zhDescription: 潮涡先聚拢并浸湿敌人，海啸穿过风眼，终末潮爆将目标推离中心。 熄火、附着潮湿并使后续雷击传导。 首次命中：对命中者施加浸湿熄火、牵引；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加牵引，整次施法最多6次，整次施法共用间隔至少1.0秒；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加击退。

On the first hit: to the struck target apply douse, pull; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply pull, at most 6 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 1.0 seconds; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): to the last struck target apply push.

spells.zhDescription: 旋风聚敌并卷起，轨道风刃护卫施法者，最终地面风浪将敌人抛出。 推动目标并悬空，冲散持续领域。 首次命中：对命中者施加挑空、牵引；持续期间（按末次命中状态判断）：在记录的落点施加牵引，整次施法最多6次，整次施法共用间隔至少1.0秒；效果结束（按末次命中状态判断）：对最后命中者施加击退。

Grants brief resistance, slows struck enemies and grounds rising targets. On the first hit: to the struck target apply root, slam; During the effect (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply slam, at most 6 times per cast, a shared interval per cast of at least 1.0 seconds; When the effect ends (using the last hit snapshot): at the recorded position apply area burst.

spells.enDescription: A conductive brand locks onto a target, a thunder domain paralyzes, and chain arcs spread from the branded enemy.
